title: Binary Search in 20 Checks
objective: Show that binary search finds an item among 1,000,000 sorted items in at most 20 checks, because each check discards half.

key_points: A linear scan may need up to 1,000,000 checks
Each check discards half of what remains

research.reason: Only arithmetic: ceil(log2(1,000,000)) = 20 and repeated halving, both checked in code. No external factual claims.

creative_directions.name: Bars halving
creative_directions.concept: The million items are a field of bars; each check visibly discards half and the camera follows what remains, until one bar is left and the number 20 lands.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: The halving is the idea, so the picture is the halving.

success_criteria: QA findings are explained, not hidden
